create_image_decoder: create an ImageDecoder instance with an optional device and pin_memory setting
decode_image_from_memory_block: decode a MemoryBlock containing raw image bytes into a Tensor with metadata using ImageDecoder
inspect_image_decoder_output: inspect the ImageDecoderOutput TypedDict fields including bit_depth, color_type, channels, height, width, and image tensor

review_image_decoder_api: review the ImageDecoder class and ImageDecoderOutput TypedDict to understand fairseq2 image decoding capabilities
